changeNote: 2026-10-02: novi GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv/CVE-2026-85393 pogodio je nepromijenjeni Netlify CLI dev-lanac netlify-cli -> @netlify/images -> ipx -> listhen -> node-forge. exceptions.mitigation: Samo dev/tooling lanac; `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` mora ostati 0. Kanonski Lekta release koristi `netlify status`, `netlify build` i `netlify deploy`, ne `netlify dev --https`, gdje listhen koristi node-forge za self-signed cert podrsku. Ne pokretati Netlify lokalni HTTPS dev server do zakrpe. Pratiti digitalbazaar/forge#1152 i odmah ukloniti iznimku nakon objave node-forge 1.4.1 ili Netlify izdanja koje uklanja lanac.
